job.question: What evaluation criteria and percentage weights does the Santa Barbara County Employees' Retirement System (SBCERS) global custody RFP use to evaluate respondents?
job.expected_facts: 1. Scope Affirmation, Servicing Approach, and Institutional Credentials - 30%; 2. Core and Value Added Services and Technology Platforms - 40%; 3. Quality of Responses and Additional Evidence of Capability - 5%; 4. Competitiveness and Reasonableness of Economics - 25%.
job.acceptance: All four categories and 30/40/5/25%; allow synonymous category descriptions.

reviews.reason: This is an Indiana Public Retirement System audit-services RFP, not the SBCERS global custody RFP. Its evaluation criteria do not provide the four requested categories or their percentage weights.
quotes: Request for Proposals (“RFP”) for Audit Services for the Indiana Public Retirement System (“INPRS” or the “System”)
INPRS is issuing this RFP in accordance with Indiana statutes governing the procurement of services and certain administrative policies of INPRS.
Specific criteria include: 1. Fulfilling the requirements set forth in the RFP 2. Technical knowledge, skills, and other competencies 3. Respondent qualifications
